name: 2FATouchCore
description: Full TOTP/2FA authenticator core library for ESP32 CYD (Cheap Yellow Display). Bilingual (English / Portuguese) UI for TFT + captive web, Wi-Fi scan + touch keyboard, weather widget, QR code generator, SD card file manager with streamed i18n-enabled static HTML pages (list / view / edit / upload), vault mode, YubiKey emulation and Creeper animations.
